<description>
Follow up suggested in https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/36791#discussion_r4568050151.

`waitNext` measures its timeout and 1-second fee tick with the wall clock, while `waitTipChanged` uses the steady clock. This means a wall clock jump changes how long `waitNext` waits, and it never times out while mocktime is frozen.

Use the steady clock for the deadline and tick. `NodeClock` is kept only for the testnet 20-minute rule, which must compare node time with the tip's timestamp.
</description>
